name: unitetolove-open-data
title: uniteTOlove open data
description: The cleaned civic datasets behind unitetolove.ca — Ontario population, municipal finances, rental markets, homelessness counts, collisions, and municipal council resolutions.

fields.name: sgc_code
fields.description: Statistics Canada SGC 2021 code. PR=2 digits, CD=4 digits, CSD=7 digits, zero-padded, stored as text.

fields.name: geo_name
fields.description: Official SGC name, e.g. "Toronto", "Wellington County", "Ontario".

fields.name: geo_level
fields.description: PR | CD | CSD.

fields.name: period
fields.description: ISO date or year for point-in-time; YYYY for annual; YYYY-MM for monthly (CMHC).

fields.name: metric
fields.description: Controlled vocabulary, per source family.

fields.name: value
fields.description: Raw value, no derived ratios computed at ingest.

fields.name: unit
fields.description: e.g. count, CAD, percent, dollars_per_month.

fields.name: source_res_id
fields.description: Pointer to the RES- registry row documenting exact download, SHA-256, retrieval method.

fields.name: retrieved_date
fields.description: When this row's underlying file was actually fetched.

fields.name: municipality
fields.description: The municipality making the ask.

fields.description: Statistics Canada SGC 2021 code for the municipality.

fields.description: The issue this ask belongs to, matching this site's issue taxonomy.

fields.name: resolution_date
fields.description: Date the council resolution or ask was recorded.

fields.description: Plain-language summary of what was asked for.

fields.name: addressee_institution
fields.description: Which government the ask was directed at (provincial/federal).

fields.name: source_url
fields.description: Primary source for this ask.

fields.description: Verification tier for this row.
